_doc: #298: the line under a character's name on the Trombinoscope (and the studio header), written for the learner in the interface language. It is the ONLY text a cast card shows about who someone is: never copy world.json cast[].role / dynamic_with_user, which are briefs for the writers. Say only what the learner has seen by that person's first page, name nobody who comes later, no plot, no planning notation. tests/test_cast_card_298.py guards it.

margaux_barman.en: Runs Le Mistral. Says very little, sees everything.
margaux_barman.de: Führt das Mistral. Sagt wenig, sieht alles.
margaux_barman.fr: Tient Le Mistral. Parle peu, voit tout.

augustin_de_roncourt.en: A regular. Theatrical, always in the middle of a story.
augustin_de_roncourt.de: Stammgast. Theatralisch, immer mitten in einer Geschichte.
augustin_de_roncourt.fr: Un habitué. Théâtral, toujours au milieu d'une histoire.

marin_leveque.de: Stammgast. Herzlich, sentimental, kocht für alle.
